user_definition: 行李正式进入系统到到达目标为止的时间
user_EBS_answer: 入库、出库两段分别计时再相加，不含EBS存储时间
included: All elapsed time during each leg, including device traversal, detours and any internal waiting. Under the new no-stop physical contract, additional internal waiting must be zero; positive device traversal remains2s.
excluded: Pre-admission external hold and intermediate EBS storage; both are reported separately.
aggregation: Per original business bag, then full-population mean/min/median/p95/p99/max. Do not replace original bag denominator by segment denominator.
